### Brand Guidelines
# Brand Style Guide: Raat3Baje

## Essence (read first)
Face-led INDIAN horror investigation and folklore channel (evolved from the Case13B concept). The creator is the recognisable on-camera host. "Khayal3Baje tells animated horror stories. Raat3Baje investigates the story behind the story." It must never become a face-camera Khayal3Baje.
- **Universe:** Indian regional horror folklore; rare and obscure entities (Munja, Hadal, Jakhin, Nishi Daak, Chhalawa, Palta Hua Pair / reversed-foot bride, Pishach, Masaan, Brahmarakshasa, Vetala, Dayan/Chudail traditions); alleged enc
content.result_snippet:
Ye ek original fictional kahani hai, lekin is kahani ki jad hamare purane railway folklore mein hai. Chhoti si town ka naam nahi lenge, kyunki station ka board kab ka tootkar gir chuka hai. Bas itna jaaniye ki Sitapur Road ke us purane station par raat ki duty Ramdhan Yadav ki thi. Chalis saal ki naukri, aur ek hi shift. Raat 11 se subah 6 tak.

Platform number do par ek lakdi ki bench thi, ek tin ka shed tha, aur ek lamp jo kabhi jalti thi, kabhi nahi.

Station 1996 mein band ho gaya tha. Patriyan aaj bhi wahan hain, lekin un par koi gaadi nahi aati. Ramdhan ke liye ye bas ek khaali jagah thi, jahan wo chai garam karta aur apni register mein likhta: "Sab theek."

Us raat hawa ruki hui thi. Na jhingur ki awaaz, na kutton ka bhonkna. Bas ghadi ki tick-tick.

Phir 2 baj kar 40 minute par, door se ek seeti aayi.

Ramdhan ne chai ka glass neeche rakha. (pause) Seeti phir aayi. Is baar lambi, jaise koi gaadi bahut dheere reng rahi ho.

[Patriyon ke us paar andhera tha, phir bhi do halki peeli batiyan dikhayi deen. Engine ki roshni.]

Ramdhan ke haath kaampne lage. Usne khud se kaha, "Ye 2:40 wali local hai... jo 1996 mein aakhri baar chali thi. Uske baad kabhi nahi chali."

(long pause)

Tabhi khaali bench se kisi ne dheere se kaha, "Ramdhan bhaiya, gaadi ruk gayi hai. Tikat dikhaoge?"
